phases.name: Water Comfort
phases.description: Get comfortable in the water with short swim-rest intervals
phases.coachNote: Focus on exhaling underwater and turning to breathe. Don't hold your breath! Rest as needed between sets.

phases.name: Building Endurance
phases.description: Extend swim intervals and reduce rest
phases.coachNote: Try to reduce rest between sets. Focus on long, smooth strokes rather than speed.

phases.name: Swim Confidently
phases.coachNote: By week 8, aim for 200m non-stop. This is a major milestone for any beginner swimmer!

Tue.name: Swim 25m + Rest 30s × 8 sets
Tue.coachNote: Total 200m. Focus on exhaling underwater. Rest as needed.

Thu.name: Kickboard 25m + Swim 25m × 6 sets
Thu.coachNote: Alternate kickboard and swim. Build leg strength.

Sat.name: Swim 25m + Rest 20s × 10 sets
Sat.coachNote: Total 250m. Try to reduce rest between sets.

Tue.name: Swim 50m + Rest 30s × 6 sets
Tue.coachNote: Total 300m. Focus on stroke efficiency - long and smooth.

Thu.name: Swim 25m + Rest 15s × 10 sets
Thu.coachNote: Short rests now. Building fitness fast!

Thu.name: Swim 50m + Kick 25m × 6 sets
Thu.coachNote: Mix swimming and kicking. Technique work.

Sat.name: Swim 200m non-stop
Sat.coachNote: 200m continuous! You've earned this. Breathe rhythmically.

trainingPlan.name: 8-Week Beginner Swim
trainingPlan.description: A beginner-friendly swim plan using interval training to build from 25m sets to 200m continuous swimming.
trainingPlan.goal: Build confidence in the water and swim 200m non-stop
